title: A civilization similator with smart character ai on mobile
author: Cultural_Bet_1714
selftext: I'm looking for a mobile game that is a top down game where there are creatures with smart ai that can build building and make a civilization and function with each other without my help but I can still help then but I can interact with them and I can do anything to them from taking down building to making fires or to dropping gold everywhere. Similar to the new netflix game Thronglets but a game that you actually progress in and i could basically be their god but if you know any please help me.

comments.author: aigamedev-ModTeam
comments.body: This post is not specific to AI based game development. See rule #1.

comments.author: dedo017
comments.body:
That idea sounds amazing — like a sandbox sim with smart little AI creatures running around? I’d play that in a heartbeat if it existed on mobile.

Totally not the same vibe, but I’ve been playing this match-3 game lately called Ocean Odyssey. It’s super simple — just an underwater-themed puzzle game with 100 levels. As you get further, it gets trickier, and there are a few power-ups. Nothing deep or AI-driven, just something chill to mess around with when I need a break.

If you’re into match 3 at all, might be worth checking out
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.puretoneix.oceanodyssey
